sources.entry: WriteMapper - Get from idea to final draft in no time.

summary.name: WriteMapper
summary.one_liner: WriteMapper is a mind-mapping app for macOS and Windows that turns a mind map's nested structure into an outline and exportable final draft.
use_cases: Turning brainstormed ideas into a structured outline
Overcoming writer's block with visual idea mapping
Drafting articles or analysis from a mind map
Exporting a finished draft to a file or clipboard
summary.what_it_does: WriteMapper lets users capture and organize ideas as mind map nodes, then double-click any node to edit its contents. It uses the nested structure of the map to create a final draft automatically and export it to several file formats, or copy it to the clipboard for pasting elsewhere. The page also describes styling and formatting options, file import to start from an existing document, a short intro tutorial, and an optional AI ideation feature. A fully-featured 7-day free trial is offered.
notable: Mind map nodes map directly to a nested outline and exported draft
Export to multiple file formats or straight to clipboard
Listed in awesome-mac under prototyping and mind-mapping tools
caveats: Only a 7-day free trial is mentioned; paid tier pricing is not stated on the page
Platforms listed are macOS and Windows only
